_doc: The weather (design/seasons/seasons-and-calamities-spec.md §3; build item N-4.5.1). Every region has weather each day, drawn once from the soul's seed, so the year's weather is the same in every life. kinds: name, glyph colour, wind (0-3, the range a day draws from), sight_m (how far you see by day), temp, and the world inputs N-4.5.2 will read (wet, dry, fire_spread, freezes, snow_cover; not read yet). say: what Aldous says when you ask about tomorrow. climates: per season, the weights of each kind (out of 100). regions: the climate each region uses (default for the rest). double: kinds whose weight doubles in a moon. max_run: the longest run of days a kind can have (the next is drawn again without it). pinned: days whose weather is fixed (every calamity, by its calendar event, in the regions it strikes). dirs: the eight wind directions, the way the wind blows from.

clear.name: Clear
clear.say: Clear tomorrow. Puddles'll be gone by noon.

overcast.name: Overcast
overcast.say: Grey tomorrow. No rain in it, but it'll be dark early.

mist.name: Mist
mist.say: Mist off the rim tomorrow. You'll not see your own hand past the gate.

rain.name: Rain
rain.say: Rain tomorrow, the whole day. Nothing'll burn outside, so don't try.

storm.name: Storm
storm.say: Storm tomorrow. Keep clear of anything iron and tall.

wind.name: Wind
wind.say: Wind tomorrow, a hard one. Mind your fires, it'll carry sparks a long way.

heat.name: Heat
heat.say: Heat tomorrow. The stubble will go up if you look at it wrong.

frost.name: Frost
frost.say: Frost tonight. The puddles will hold you till noon, near enough.

snow.name: Snow
snow.say: Snow tomorrow. You'll see every track in the camp, and so will they.

plateau._doc: Ring 1, the Vellmar plateau: high, cold, windy and misty (spec §3.3).
